color.note: Light only — there is no dark theme. One accent (primary) for actions and progress; orange (highlight) only for muscles and streaks.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Main actions, links, progress fills, active states, the active tab-bar pill. As text: 5.5:1 on canvas, 5.2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: primary-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed state of button-primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary or primary-deep fill (7.6:1 / 5.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-300
tokens.usage: Completed set-row background, heatmap level 2, light chart series; the chibi's sweat drop and water bottle. Text on it is ink (10.4:1).

tokens.name: accent-500
tokens.usage: Completed set-row border, heatmap level 3, chart series, the rest TimerRing and the current StepProgress segment. 3.2:1 on canvas — a mark, never body text.

tokens.name: accent-700
tokens.usage: Heatmap level 4 and the strongest chart series. Same value as primary.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Only for worked muscles (the chibi's muscle glow), streaks and the chibi's cheer sparks. 2.5:1 on canvas — never text; pair with a label.

tokens.name: highlight-soft
tokens.usage: Background of muscle-chip and streak-badge (text ink, 13.8:1); the chibi's blush.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Footer background only (footer-region). Not a background anywhere else.

tokens.name: sand-light
tokens.usage: Unused — the active exercise-card now uses surface. Do not use as a background.

tokens.name: sand-deeper
tokens.usage: Unused — the stage and the neutral badge moved to neutral tokens. Do not use as a background.

tokens.name: sand-border
tokens.usage: Unused — surface areas take hairline borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface and the footer's sand (15:1 or more); fill of button-ink, toast and active pill-tab; active tab-bar label.

tokens.name: ink-tint
tokens.usage: Strong secondary text on canvas and surface; the chibi's hair and shoes.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text on canvas and sand (7.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Captions and inactive tab labels on canvas (4.9:1) and surface (4.7:1); borders of controls whose border carries the state — checkbox, round step markers, planned status (4.9:1, above the 3:1 floor).

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Tertiary meta and icons on canvas; the Switch track when off (3.2:1 — enough for a control, not for small text). Below 4.5:1 for small text, use only for 18px+ or non-essential meta.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled text. 2.1:1 on canvas — source value kept; never for information a person needs.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, set-row border, borders of surface areas (stage, rest-timer, form-panel, CTA, card-neutral, button-neutral), neutral badge background, progress track, heatmap level 1, disabled button fill.

tokens.name: hairline-soft
tokens.usage: Card borders (card-base, exercise-card), bottom-tab-bar top rule.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Input, stepper, button-secondary and icon-button borders. 1.6:1 — decorative, so the label and a 44px height carry the control.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page and card background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one tinted background: the soft disc under the chibi on TrainingScreen, exercise-stage and its static previews, the active exercise-card, rest-timer, form-panel, hero-band, CTA banner, card-neutral, button-neutral. Give it a 1px hairline border where it sits on canvas as a panel (not the disc).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (17:1).

tokens.name: on-sand
tokens.usage: Text on the footer's sand (15:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind Dialog and BottomSheet (ink at 40%).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on canvas and sand. Same value as primary.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done states — always with a check icon. 3.5:1 on canvas: icons and 18px+ text only.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings such as a skipped warm-up — always with an icon and text in ink. Never text itself.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and delete: error input border, error icon, the danger button fill (white text 4.5:1). As text 4.5:1 on canvas only — field error messages are ink next to a danger icon.

tokens.name: character-skin-1
tokens.usage: Character skin tone, light.

tokens.name: character-skin-2
tokens.usage: Character skin tone, medium.

tokens.name: character-skin-3
tokens.usage: Character skin tone, deep.

tokens.name: character-outfit-1
tokens.usage: Character outfit, teal.

tokens.name: character-outfit-2
tokens.usage: Character outfit, blue.

tokens.name: character-outfit-3
tokens.usage: Character outfit, orange.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces (Google Fonts, OFL) — hero, page titles and stat numbers.

styles.name: stat-display
styles.usage: Stat numbers: volume, minutes, streak days. Always tabular-nums.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Inter (Google Fonts, OFL) — all interface text.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Персонажи показывают технику — вы отмечаете подходы.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: Держите спину прямой и опускайтесь до параллели.

styles.name: micro-uppercase
styles.usage: Eyebrows and muscle-group labels; set uppercase.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Workout values — always font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits don't jump.

styles.name: set-value
styles.usage: Weight × reps in set rows and steppers.

tokens.name: spacing-xxs
tokens.usage: Chip vertical padding, icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: spacing-xs
tokens.usage: Pill-tab vertical padding, tight gaps.

tokens.name: spacing-sm
tokens.usage: Set-row, input and toast vertical padding.

tokens.name: spacing-md
tokens.usage: Exercise-card padding; mobile page edge.

tokens.name: spacing-lg
tokens.usage: Exercise-stage and stat-cell padding.

tokens.name: spacing-xl
tokens.usage: Card-base padding, FAQ item padding; app section gaps.

tokens.name: spacing-xxl
tokens.usage: Card-sand, card-elevated, form-panel, rest-timer padding; landing gutter.

tokens.name: spacing-xxxl
tokens.usage: Large gaps inside landing sections.

tokens.name: spacing-section-sm
tokens.usage: Compact section spacing.

tokens.name: spacing-section
tokens.usage: CTA banner and footer padding.

tokens.name: spacing-section-lg
tokens.usage: Landing section spacing.

tokens.name: spacing-hero
tokens.usage: Hero-band padding.

radius.note: Restrained: buttons 8px, cards 12px. Pills only for badges, chips and tabs.

tokens.name: rounded-xs
tokens.usage: Heatmap cells.

tokens.name: rounded-sm
tokens.usage: Compact elements.

tokens.name: rounded-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, steppers, set rows, toast.

tokens.name: rounded-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, exercise-stage, form-panel.

tokens.name: rounded-xl
tokens.usage: Rest timer, large panels.

tokens.name: rounded-xxl
tokens.usage: Extra-large panels.

tokens.name: rounded-full
tokens.usage: Badges, muscle chips, pill tabs, round icon buttons — never text buttons.

shadow.note: Borders first; shadows are rare and soft.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Hover on tiles.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: card-elevated.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Modals, dropdowns, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px canvas gap, then 2px of solid primary (5.5:1 on canvas, 4.9:1 on sand). Intentional addition — the source only defines the input's focus border.

size.note: Fixed sizes from the component specs.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons, inputs, steppers, tabs; icon-button and set checkbox hit area 44×44.

tokens.name: size-tab-bar
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom-tab-bar height.

tokens.name: size-heatmap-cell
tokens.usage: Activity heatmap cell.

tokens.name: size-progress
tokens.usage: Progress-bar height and progress-ring stroke width.

tokens.name: size-stage-action
tokens.usage: Side buttons around the character on the workout screen (RoundAction sm).

tokens.name: size-key-action
tokens.usage: The one key action under the character (RoundAction key); TimerRing is 168px.

tokens.name: layout-landing-max
tokens.usage: Landing container max-width (32px gutters).

tokens.name: layout-sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop app side navigation width.

tokens.name: layout-content-max
tokens.usage: Desktop app content max-width.

tokens.name: bp-mobile-large
tokens.usage: Two exercise cards per row in the catalog; hero 48px.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Two columns; sidebar collapses to icons.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Sidebar + content; hero 64px.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Full 72px hero.
